name: Echo Memory
description: An echo with a long memory: under the repeats, moments from the last minute of playing drift back, sometimes backwards or at half speed.

params.name: Time
params.description: The gap between the echo's repeats. Moving it bends the pitch of the repeats that are already sounding.

params.name: Feedback
params.description: How much of each echo is repeated again. Low gives one or two repeats, high a long trail that slowly darkens.

params.name: Echo
params.description: Level of the ordinary echo. At zero only the recalled moments are heard.

params.name: Memory
params.description: Level of the moments brought back from earlier in the performance. At zero the device is a plain echo.

params.name: Reach
params.description: How far back the memory can go. Short keeps to what was just played; long lets a phrase from a minute ago return, fainter the older it is.

params.name: Wander
params.description: How often the memory goes somewhere new. Low recalls a moment now and then with silence between; high flickers between short glimpses several times a second.

params.name: Size
params.description: How long each recalled moment lasts. Short gives glimpses of single notes, long brings back whole phrases under a slow fade. A busy Wander cuts moments shorter.

params.name: Vary
params.description: The chance that a moment comes back changed: backwards, an octave down at half speed, or an octave up at double speed. At zero everything returns as it was played.

params.name: Build Up
params.description: On records what the memory plays back into the memory, quieter each time, so memories of memories build up and slowly fade.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Rolls the highs off the echoes and the recalled moments. Lower is darker and further away, and each echo repeat is darker than the last.

params.name: Spread
params.description: How wide the recalled moments are placed, each at its own position. It also bounces the echo's repeats from side to side.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the echoes and memories.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit; not a model of any unit. A feedback echo beside a recording of about the last minute of the input, kept as 16-bit stereo with triangular dither and a map of how loud each tenth of a second was. Two snippet voices bring back moments from it, chosen by seeded chance weighted towards where there was sound, each under a slow raised-cosine window: as played, backwards, or at half or double speed through windowed-sinc interpolation. The recall granulates a delay line, after the approach of Barry Truax, 'Real-Time Granular Synthesis with a Digital Signal Processor'; the dither is after the approach of Lipshitz, Wannamaker and Vanderkooy, 'Quantization and Dither: A Theoretical Survey'; the interpolation is after the approach of Smith and Gossett, 'A Flexible Sampling-Rate Conversion Method'.
